nyc_statutory_tax_note.formula: 14.75% (5.875% NYC Hotel Room Occupancy Tax + 8.875% combined NYS/NYC/MCTD sales tax) + $3.50/night ($2.00 NYC room occupancy fee + $1.50 NYS hotel unit fee)
nyc_statutory_tax_note.booking_display_note: Booking.com rounds the $3.50 statutory flat unit fee up to '$4 City tax per night' on most Manhattan listings ($6/night on multi-room/suite classifications such as Residence Inn FiDi).
